panel.intro: Keep new workspaces within reach. Choose a default, then make exceptions for individual projects.
panel.defaultOn: On for projects without an override.
panel.defaultOff: Off for projects without an override.
panel.defaultHint: Projects set to Always or Never override this default.
panel.rulesHint: Always pins new workspaces in that project. Never leaves them unpinned.
panel.emptyHint: Add a project in Paseo to give it its own auto-pin rule.
panel.notReady: Auto-Pin is not ready. Try reloading the plugin.
panel.footer: Rules apply when a workspace is created. Existing pins and restored workspaces stay as they are.
